Introduction

GamJay is the Main Vocalist and President of the 5-member Virtual boy group Psychord. He debuted with them on February 23, 2023, with their debut single "Crazier".On April 11, 2024, he made his solo debut with the EP (Extended Play) "Missed Call". His birthday is on July 17 of a unknown year.
